label: Bible Study
prompt: My brethren, count it all _____ when ye fall into divers temptations;
verse: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
note: James opens his letter with the strangest instruction — count trials as joy.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my _____, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
verse: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
note: Quoting Psalm 118, the writer turns 'I will not fear' into something we can boldly say out loud.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is _____, but the flesh is weak.
verse: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
note: Everyone quotes 'the spirit is willing,' but the KJV in Mark says the spirit truly is 'ready.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: And _____ your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
verse: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
note: Tearing your robe was the classic grief gesture; Joel says God wants the heart torn instead — the clothes can stay.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For Ezra had _____ his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.
verse: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.
note: Ezra's order of operations: seek, do, then teach — and first he 'prepared his heart.'
